posts.content_md: I'm curious about edge-lit holography; I don't see how they can uniformly illuminate a hologram from the side, but assuming it's possible, I wonder how this part of the field differs from holography where the reference beam is perpendicular to the recording material. I also wonder what uses this has in re: volume holography and the bragg angle...

posts.post_subject: Open Call for Information on Edge-Lit Holography
posts.content_md:
> I don't see how they can uniformly illuminate a hologram from the side

It's easy! Just use a prism and index matching fluid. The most recent holograms I've made at home (last fall) were 4"x4" edge-lit transmission HOEs for a fingerprint capture device. Properties of edge-lit holograms are in between transmission and reflection. Shrinkage control is much more important. Controlling beam ratios and stray light is also more difficult.
